entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The long gravel drive ran through the middle of lush, neat lawns.
entries.zh: 长长的砂砾驱动器穿过了茂密,整洁的草坪中间.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The manor house was surrounded by high, red-brick walls.
entries.zh: 庄园的房屋被高高的红砖墙包围.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The gates to the long, sweeping drive were flanked with statues of enormous stone lions.
entries.zh: 通往漫长、扫荡的车道的大门被巨大的石狮雕像包围。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wooden gate was hidden by a huge maple tree.
entries.zh: 木门被一棵巨大的枫树所隐藏.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The arched gateway dripped with slime.
entries.zh: 拱门滴满了粘液

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was impossible to see what lay behind the high gates.
entries.zh: 无法看到高门后面有什么

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The gate was set in the wall and cunningly hidden in the shadows.
entries.zh: 大门被设置在墙上,狡猾地隐藏在阴影中.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Weeds and ivy had eaten their way into the cracks of the wall and spread their tentacles into every crevice.
entries.zh: 杂草和常春藤都吃进墙壁的裂缝里 把触手伸进每个裂缝里

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Bushes crept and wriggled over the drive, which was now just a thin strip steeped in shadow.
entries.zh: 布希斯在驱动器上扭动和扭动,现在这个驱动器只是一条在阴影中陡峭的薄条.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The warehouse was surrounded by a tall fence, at least three metres high, topped with steel spikes and razor wire.
entries.zh: 仓库周围有一个高高的栅栏,至少高3米,上面有钢钉和剃刀线。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The drive was paved, but grass grew in every crevice and moss clung to the surface like mould on bread.
entries.zh: 驱动器是铺面的, 但草生长 在每一个裂缝和苔藓 粘在表面 像模具在面包上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They looked through the twisted railings and in front of them in the gloom were dark, crumbling stones, thorny bushes and knee-high grass. Beyond loomed the ghostly shadow of the house.
entries.zh: 他们穿过扭曲的栏杆,在暗处的他们面前是黑暗的、折叠的石头、棘状的灌木丛和高膝的草丛。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The back of the house was a huge carpet of lush, green grass.
entries.zh: 房子的后面是一大片绿草的地毯。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Grassy slopes rolled down from the house to a beautiful wilderness of huge trees and wild flowers.
entries.zh: 草坡从屋里滚落到一个巨大的树木和野花的美丽荒野.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Huge terracotta pots, brimming with brightly coloured flowers, sat either side of the front door.
entries.zh: 巨大的三角形罐子, 充满明亮的彩色花朵, 坐在前门的两边。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Brightly coloured plants were arranged in symmetrical rows and colours, and bordered the edge of the lawn.
entries.zh: 明亮的彩色植物被排列成对称的排列线和颜色,与草坪边缘相邻.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Honeysuckle clung to the majestic oak tree, which spread its enormous limbs over the centre of the garden.
entries.zh: 蜂蜜紧贴着雄伟的橡树 树将巨大的四肢伸向花园的中心

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The front garden was wild and overgrown.
entries.zh: 前面的花园是野生和过度生长的.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Plastic bags instead of blossoms flapped on the bushes.
entries.zh: 塑料袋,而不是花朵在灌木丛上闪烁

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a spidery tangle of trees, bushes, weeds and long, knee-high grass.
entries.zh: 原为树,灌木丛,杂草和长长,膝高的草丛的蜘蛛状缠绕.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The grass was withered and brown, and the flowers wilting, starved of water and choked with weeds.
entries.zh: 草枯褐色,花枯, 饿死水, 窒息的杂草。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The garden was full of junk: battered, old furniture, rusty metal frames and rubbish bags ripped and spewing their contents on the ground.
entries.zh: 花园里满是垃圾:被打烂的旧家具、生锈的金属框架和垃圾袋被撕破,在地上挖东西。
